title: Phase execution state
description: Machine-readable resume state for a single phase. Git is always the source of truth; this file is a convenience mirror. See docs/phase-workflow/README.md.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of this file. Bump when the shape changes.

phaseId.description: Phase identifier, e.g. "5.17" or "5.18.1". Must match the README phase-id marker and the directory name.

activeStage.description: Stage currently being worked, e.g. "P5.17-00" or "P5.18.1-00". Null when the phase is complete.

completedStages.description: Stage ids that are fully done, each with recorded gates and a commit hash.

blocked.description: True when a stop condition is active. Must agree with status and blockerReason.

blockerReason.description: Non-null free text when blocked is true; null otherwise.

baseCommit.description: Commit the phase branch was created from.

lastVerifiedCommit.description: Most recent commit whose gates were actually run and recorded.

currentBranch.description: Git branch that carries this phase's work.

requiredGates.description: Map of stage id -> array of gate names that must pass before the stage is completed.

gateResults.description: Map of gate name -> result. Only "pass" counts as passed.

nextAction.description: Single next concrete action to resume from.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Advisory only; never overrides Git reality.
